about: Unicode 18.0.0's IdnaTestV2.txt, each row resolved by the file's own rules and re-encoded as one vector per line: {line, source, toUnicode, toUnicodeError, toASCIIN, toASCIIT, age?}. A blank toUnicode is the source, a blank toAsciiN is toUnicode and a blank toAsciiT is toAsciiN. A blank toUnicodeStatus is [], a blank toAsciiNStatus is toUnicodeStatus and a blank toAsciiTStatus is toAsciiNStatus. toASCIIN and toASCIIT are null unless their status is []. toUnicodeError is false only for [] and [X4_2], as in tr46's test/unicode.js. The options are tr46's test/unicode.js's. Real tr46 7.0.0 gives every one of these answers, which the generator asserts. The 2 rows whose source holds a lone surrogate are left out, because a Swift String can't hold one. age is the highest DerivedAge among the assigned code points of the source, its two mapped forms and the expected answers, present only above 14.0; the .foundation comparison skips those vectors.
